evidence.dom: 【dom=50】FY2025 10-K(CIK 0001056696, acc 0001193125-26-037138, manh-20251231.htm)Item1『Competition』は同等ソリューションの供給者を実名で多数列挙する: 『Our competitors are diverse and offer a variety of solutions directed at various aspects of enterprise commerce. Existing competitors include: Corporate information technology departments of current or potential customers capable of internally developing solutions; ERP vendors, including: Oracle, SAP and Infor, among others; Supply chain execution and planning vendors, including Blue Yonder/Panasonic (formerly JDA), E2Open, Infios (formerly Korber, HighJump), SAS Institute, the Sterling Commerce division of IBM, Relex, and others; POS vendors, including Aptos, Oracle, Jumpmind, Salesforce and others; and Smaller independent companies』。さらに自社より大きい競合の存在を明記する: 『Some of these ERP and other potential competitors have longer operating histories; significantly more financial, technical, marketing, and other resources; greater name recognition; broader solutions; and larger installed bases of customers than us』。MD&Aも中核市場を『core omnichannel operation ..., supply chain commerce operations (Warehouse Management, Transportation Management and Labor Management), and inventory optimization, which are intensely competitive markets characterized by rapid technological change』とする。同等品を多数社が供給し、かつ自社より大きい導入基盤を持つ競合が複数いる＝自社が40%以上を占めることは構造上ありえない → 刻み50(競争<40%、寡占構造にも非該当)。v9.9.41 規約3(50は残余の刻みで構造記述があれば数値なしで確定・ここを空欄にしない)に従い50を確定。なお『We are a market leader in the supply chain management and omnichannel software solutions market as defined by industry analysts such as ARC Advisory Group and Gartner』は順位の自称(数値なし)で、どの刻みの証拠にもならない(規約4)ため採らない。出典: SEC 10-K FY2025 manh-20251231.htm Item1 Competition / Item1A / Item7 Revenue
